# CineWindows v1.0.3

## Highlights

- Automatic RIFE setup now uses the portable ncnn backend when SVP or TensorRT is not available.
- RIFE downloads are safer and more complete, with atomic writes, backend validation, and the correct RIFE v4 model files.
- Preferences now show inline download progress only when setup is available or running, avoiding the empty space before download starts.
- Interpolation engine selection is more reliable: TensorRT is used only when a valid backend exists, while Automatic falls back to ncnn.
- Cursor-centric Ctrl + mouse wheel zoom has been added, with video alignment reset when zoom returns to zero.

## Packaging

- App, installer, and launcher metadata are bumped to `1.0.3`.
- Release automation now publishes Windows x64 ZIP and NSIS installer artifacts from tagged builds.
- CI now verifies the core Python sources and VapourSynth script before release packaging.

## Notes

- Systems without SVP/TensorRT can use RIFE automatically through the portable ncnn backend.
- TensorRT remains supported when a valid SVP or vs-mlrt TensorRT backend is installed.
